create_temp_directory_context: create a temporary directory with a given prefix that is automatically cleaned up after use
recompress_zip_local: recompress a local zip file using DEFLATED compression and write it to a new output file
recompress_zip_remote: recompress a zip file from any path supported by iopath and write the result back
review_make_temp_directory: review the make_temp_directory context manager to understand how it creates and cleans up temp directories
refactor_recompress_export: refactor the recompress_export function to support additional compression levels or streaming large files
